queries: WITH media_rates AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name, COUNT(*) AS track_count, SUM(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL)) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN t.Bytes IS NOT NULL THEN t.Milliseconds END), 0) AS rate FROM Track AS t JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS average_rate FROM media_rates) SELECT r.Name, r.rate, r.track_count, r.rate - b.average_rate AS above_average FROM media_rates AS r CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE r.rate > b.average_rate

assumptions.assumption: A media type's rate is its total known bytes divided by the total milliseconds of those same tracks. Track count includes every track with a matching media type.

alternatives.interpretation: The rate is the average of individual tracks' bytes-per-millisecond rates.
